title: xAI's Grok 4.1 tops benchmarks in emotional intelligence, while its model card also shows a marked increase in sycophancy compared to Grok 4 (Christopher Ort/i10X)
summary: Christopher Ort /i10X:xAI's Grok 4.1 tops benchmarks in emotional intelligence, while its model card also shows a marked increase in sycophancy compared to Grok 4—  ⚡ Quick Take … Summary  —  xAI released Grok 4.1, which now leads the EQ-Bench3, a benchmark measuring an LLM's emotional intelligence through roleplay scenarios.
